name: List
description: Renders an ordered, unordered, or descriptive list with optional selection, dividers, and compact spacing.

props.name: items
props.type: Array<{ id: string; label: string; description?: string }>
props.description: Array of list items to render

props.name: selectable
props.description: Makes items clickable and highlights the selected item

props.name: selectedId
props.description: ID of the currently selected item

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the item id when a selectable item is clicked

snippets.webcomponent:
<!-- Arrays must be set via JS property, not HTML attribute -->
<cl-list selectable dividers></cl-list>

<script>
  const list = document.querySelector('cl-list');
  list.items = [
    { id: '1', label: 'Item one' },
    { id: '2', label: 'Item two' },
  ];
  list.addEventListener('select', (e) => console.log('selected id:', e.detail));
</script>
